'''Xev''' was a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who was part of [[Grud]]'s crew. The group was hired by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to hunt Jedi during the [[Battle of Corellia]] but had failed complete it after being ambushed by the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]]. Eventually Grud hired a Imperial spacer to track down and kill the Jedi while Xev himself was sent to keep an eye on the spacer to ensure the job was completed.<ref name="Jedi Hunt" />
